Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

FLOSS 0.6.1

  • amat_from_lm(): age at 50% maturity from the length at maturity, inverting the growth curve. species() computes tm from lm when tm is missing or NA, so that the operating model (maturity at age) matures fish at lm.
  • Shiny app: the age at 50% maturity is computed from the length at maturity, Linf, k and t0 and updates live (read-only), so maturity at age and at length always agree.
  • Reef species (FishLife life histories; FishLife gives no t0):
    • t0 = -0.1 for the three teleosts (was -1, which put age-0 fish at 15-24 cm mid-year, at the peak of the trap selectivity, so age 0 was nearly fully selected). Blacktip reef shark keeps t0 = -1 (born large).
    • Age at maturity from FishLife’s Lm for all species (FishLife’s Lm and tm disagree): rabbitfish 1.56 (was 2.22), emperor 3.85 (4.85), snapper 3.01 (3.07), shark 5.83 (8.46).
    • Rabbitfish relq retuned (traps 0.58, gillnet 0.18, linefish 0.02; was 1.39, 0.42, 0.05) so that it stays just above Fmsy (F/Fmsy about 1.2 in 2025) as before; emperor and snapper trajectories are nearly unchanged.
    • Reproduce 0.6.0 OMs with the species files of FLOSS 0.6.0.
  • fishery(Escale): overall effort multiplier (default 1), applied to every fleet and year; reef_3fleets and reef_fishery() use 1.1, so all reef species are fished about 10% harder (2025 F/Fmsy: rabbitfish 1.29, emperor 1.24, snapper 0.84). App: “Overall effort level” next to the effort scale between iterations.
  • Sex-structured OM with growth morphs: om_sex(..., gtg = gtg_sex(stk, gtg_settings())) tracks growth-type groups separately for females and males (own Linf, k, maturity), with Beverton-Holt recruitment from female SSB split 50:50. Catch numbers come from the morph catch, so a projection at constant Fmsy returns Bmsy and MSY exactly. refpts_sex_gtg() gives morph-equilibrium Fmsy, Bmsy, MSY, B0, R0, Fcrash and Fspr30/40; eq_sex_gtg() the two-sex per-recruit and equilibrium values; sr_sex(gtg = ) sets B0 from the morph SBPR0. truth_sex() (SPR) and lfd_sex() (fleet catch and survey length samples by sex) use the morphs when present.

FLOSS 0.6.0

  • Growth morphs (growth-type groups) in the operating model: build_om(gtg = gtg_settings()) tracks morphs that differ in Linf through each cohort’s fleet F history (length-selective mortality, Rosa Lee effect); the FLStock stays standard. Length and age samples come from the morphs in each fleet’s catch. gtg_settings(n, cv) takes the total CV of Linf (within-morph CV = cv / sqrt(n), after M. Taylor’s FLR platoon code). gtg_lfq() gives the true catch at length; gtg_brp() the morph-equilibrium reference points from steepness and R0. Plots: plot_gtg_linf() (design M. Taylor), plot_gtg_growth(), plot_gtg_selectivity(), plot_gtg_lenage(), plot_gtg_lfq(), plot_gtg_spr(). Guide: floss_guide("growth-morphs").
  • fishery(Escale_cv, management): a lognormal effort scale per iteration (common to all fleets and species) and management changes (effort steps by fleet and year).
  • New defaults (reproduce earlier OMs with FLOSS 0.5.8):
    • reef_3fleets: Escale_cv = 0.25; management change cutting gillnet and linefish effort to 50% and 55% in two steps (1998, 2002).
    • Rabbitfish relq traps 1.39, gillnet 0.42. Emperor relq gillnet 1.2; traps peak at 22 cm (sd_left 6, sd_right 15); linefish L50 38, L95 48 cm. Snapper relq gillnet 0.7, linefish 0.9; traps peak at 22 cm (sd_left 6). Recruitment variability (sigmaR) unchanged.
  • as_flr() passes maturity L50 = L(tm) and L95 = L(tm + 1) as used by the OM.
  • Guides render equations as MathML (no MathJax needed).
